notice: Research recipes only. None of these entries is installed, configured, authorized or connected by this manifest. Source reference commits identify documentation snapshots, not necessarily npm release build commits. Package versions and integrity values pin package artifacts; remote server versions cannot be pinned. All tool execution remains disabled until separate host configuration and project-scoped authorization.

exclusions.reason: Official remote server restricts client access to approved clients; MWIDE is not listed.
Official docs require approval/waitlist for new MCP clients; no MWIDE approval is established.
Deprecated by AWS in favor of aws-iac-mcp-server.
github.com/prisma/mcp is archived; do not install that deprecated server.
Archived reference implementations omitted rather than presenting deprecated database servers as maintained.
